review: The verb and noun should have different stress.

text: I read books. Yesterday I read a book.
review: The second read should rhyme with red. A failed check is an engine limitation, not an alignment test to hide.

text: The Polish artist will polish the table.
review: Capitalisation must survive: Polish and polish differ.

text: Dr. Smith paid $12.50 and can't re-read it.
review: Check abbreviation pauses, currency/decimal reading, apostrophes, and hyphens. Exact mapping does not establish correct number reading.

text: It is kind of a problem.
review: eSpeak can merge of a; both must fall back explicitly rather than assigning their combined phones to of.
Exercise non-BMP characters, curly quotes, newline and multiple clauses.
Screenshot content must be treated as text, never as raw phonemes or SSML instructions.

text: Mestre bruxo! Tem um cemitério élfico nas cavernas próximas de Centrobosque.
review: Game-style dialogue and an invented place name. Listen for proper-name errors.

text: Os cintos de segurança são incríveis.
review: Compare both accents, nasal vowels, de, and word-final consonants.

text: A avó e o avô bebem café.
review: Avó and avô must preserve their different vowels.

text: A avó e o avô bebem café.
review: Same content using combining accents; displayed source offsets must still be exact.
Numbers/time expansions; mapping fallback is acceptable, wrong attribution is not.

text: Eu gosto do gosto deste café.
review: A listening check for a repeated spelling in different grammatical roles; no claim of semantic correctness.
